outcome: Postoperative maternal complications of cesarean section
cohort: 302 cases of postoperative maternal complications of cesarean section at the Provincial General Hospital of Kananga from January 1st, 2016 to December 31st, 2020
finding: Five factors were independently associated with postoperative complications of cesarean section: prolonged labor, defective hygiene of patients, uterine overdistension before cesarean section, multiparity, and emergency cesarean section.
